(updated 10-1-2026) WestRock Landing in Roland (501-658-5598) said the lake level still continues to fall, sitting as of Thursday, Oct. 1, at 11.32 feet below the normal pool level. As far as good drops go, though, the water temperature has worked itself into the 70s, being recorded Thursday at 79.5 degrees. The front ramp by WestRock remains closed. Air temperatures have climbed back to near 98 degrees this week. Largemouth bass are biting early in the morning and in the evening on topwater. (updated 10-1-2026) Angler Shaun Mercer reported that Wilson Lake, between Portland and Montrose, is extremely low. "There's not enough boat ramp to launch your boat," he said. Anglers should not plan on launching until water levels come back up.

Millwood Lake Dam is releasing about 416 cfs and the tailwater is near 224 feet and stable.
